notes.title: Proxima Divide v0.3.3
notes.content:
[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Expanded world layout: next area now partially explorable (no gameplay yet)
[*] Procedural building workflow implemented, allowing placement of buildings of any size
[*] Early interior work started for new areas
[*] Robots now perform ambient tasks (cleaning, maintenance, moving boxes) before detecting the player
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where pickaxe prompt showed incorrect slot
[*] Crash site fire now extinguishes after the first night
[*] Fixed item drop-through-floor issue (especially affecting pistol)
[*] Added drop sound effect for pistol (other items will receive sounds in future updates)
[/list]

Read more about it on the blog: [url=https://proximadivide.com/?p=219]https://proximadivide.com/?p=219[/url]

notes.title: Proxima Divide v0.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Save Slots Added – Players can now create and manage multiple save files.
[*] Pause Menu Save/Load – Save and load your progress directly from the pause menu.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed eating animations for sprats and sardines.
[*] Adjusted terrain for smoother navigation and improved visuals.
[*] Addressed saving issues and improved reliability.
[*] Fixed visibility of player character during cutscenes.
[*] Addressed several crashes and softlocks.
[/list]
[h1]Upcoming Changes[/h1]
The hovering drone enemy is being replaced by a new bipedal robot – more grounded, tactical, and visually striking.

[url=https://proximadivide.com/?p=130]Read more about it in our Dev Log[/url]
